programme.desc: As the crew heads to Puerto Rico, a massive screw-up from Teddy threatens to derail the entire trip. Melody loses her cool when Lalo refuses to make the ultimate commitment. Ceaser and Dutchess finally come face to face.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew parties on a boat off the coast of Puerto Rico but things get rocky when Ceaser exposes the truth about Nikki's past. Melody and Lalo commit their lives to each other. Dutchess makes an emotional plea to win Ceaser back.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew celebrates the grand re-opening of Black Ink. Ted is on the defense as Melody makes a power play to become manager. O'S**t reveals shocking information about Nikki. Melody catches Ceaser in a compromising position.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser and the crew turn it up at DMX's birthday party. Sky is determined to stop Kitty from becoming Ceaser's new woman. Someone from Nikki's past shows up with shocking news. And a fancy dinner ends when Sky trashes the table.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: An angry Miss Kitty confronts Ceaser about sleeping with Allison. Richard rushes to the hospital after an urgent text message from Nikki. Dutchess gets her groove back with an NFL player after hearing about Ceaser's sex life.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Sky returns to 113th and shares some big news. Ceaser attempts damage control with Miss Kitty. Sky heads to the boardroom to pitch her new workout. All hell breaks loose when Donna says Sky doesn't deserve her promotion.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser learns a shocking revelation about his relationship with Dutchess. After the loss of their baby, Richard's wife Nikki hits her breaking point. Kitty attempts to make peace with Dutchess. Bae is caught up in a new romance.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Miss Kitty refuses to back down from Dutchess. Ceaser continues to cozy up to Karlie Redd. Richard must decide whether to save his marriage. Ceaser throws a huge bash to celebrate the newest shop in his franchise.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The 113th shop is in shambles when a single Ceaser becomes more interested in chasing women. Donna receives a threatening phone call. Black Ink Atlanta's anniversary party turns into chaos. Dutchess delivers an explosive low blow to Sky.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Teddy is on edge as his brother faces life in prison. Sky makes a phone call that will change her life forever. A letter from the IRS could mean financial ruin for Melody. A brawl breaks out at Black Ink when Donna's ex-husband's sister shows up.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser receives alarming news from his doctor and resolves to change his ways. Melody is shocked by Lalo's solution to their financial issues. And Sky heads to Texas to reunite with the children she gave up for adoption 15 years ago.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When $10,000 is stolen from the shop, Ceaser tasks Sky to find the culprit. Bae freaks out when Rob wants to take their relationship to the next level. And Melody has a breakdown when Donna publicly attacks her artistry and questions her character.

programme.desc: Kat invites the crew to a lake house. Charmaine's job is in jeopardy after a night of partying. Nikki learns that Phor sent Kat roses. Ryan and Van come to blows. Charmaine is shocked when she discovers two unlikely people hooking up. Presented by VH1.

programme.sub-title: Work Is Work, But Can You Twerk?

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: At 33, all John can see is the loss in his life. His mother died when he was 12.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: A beautiful 21-year-old addicted to Norco and meth, Christina has violent outbursts, believes that bugs are crawling under her skin, and has threatened suicide. Can an intervention save Christina before she loses her mind entirely?

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Once bright, likable, and athletic, Andrew has become a gaunt, menacing OxyContin addict.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: A family begging her to get help and two overdoses in the last two weeks don't phase 21-year-old Britney as she fearlessly shoots up suboxone and bath salts up to 30 times a day.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Courtney, 20, injects heroin up to eight times a day and is a sex worker to finance her own and her boyfriend's addiction.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Jessica, 21, comes from a tight-knit family. Hubert's siblings' turn to help him overcome a horrible alcohol addiction.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Friends try to help Tamela, 24, who was molested as a child and now cuts herself with razorblades. And, a family calls in interventionist Jeff VanVonderen to help Jerrie, 29, who is addicted to Vicodin.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Trent, 33, is a four-star chef who's served U.S. presidents and Hollywood stars. But as the child of alcoholics, Trent's formative years were marked with violence and abuse. He ultimately turned to drugs to cope.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Loud and spunky 50 year-old Cher's alcohol addiction has led to liver damage and is driving a wedge between herself and her family.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Ginjer is a professional Sugar Baby who trolls "dating" websites to maintain a severe Dilaudid addiction.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Anthony has been working at the pizzerias owned by his family since he was a kid. A good athlete, colleges offered him baseball scholarships. But at 14, everything changed.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Identical twins Sonia and Julia, 22, shared everything as children and grew up in a loving home.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Tammi, 45, is an alcoholic despite being raised in an upper middle-class family that provided her with a good education and even golf and tennis lessons.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Police discover the dead body of Andrew Hopper clutching a syringe and covered with blood. The body is in Dr. G’s hands, as are the clues to solving the case.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.title: South Park: Butter's Very Own Episode
programme.desc: Butters' Very Own Episode: Butters' mum asks him to spy on his dad, however what he discovers leaves Mrs Stoch acting slightly unhinged. Will this be the end of our lil blonde haired buddy? (S5, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Professor Chaos (Part 1)
programme.desc: Professor Chaos (1): Butters is sacked by the boys as their replacement best friend for Kenny - the hunt for a new friend is on! Out for revenge, Butters becomes... Professor Chaos! (S6, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Simpsons Already Did It (Part 2)
programme.desc: Simpsons Already Did It (2): Professor Chaos gets distraught as he realises all of his plans have already appeared on The Simpsons! Cartman gets very excited about growing Sea People. (S6, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Red Hot Catholic Love
programme.desc: Red Hot Catholic Love: A sexual abuse scandal involving priests hits South Park and is taken all the way to the Vatican. (S6, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Free Hat
programme.desc: Free Hat: Kyle, Stan, Cartman & Tweek get angry about Steven Spielberg and George Lucas' habit of altering their films with each "re-re-re-release". They go on a mission to steal the movies.(S6, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Bebe's B**bs Destroy Society
programme.desc: Bebe's B**bs Destroy Society: Returning from school break, all the boys notice something different about Bebe... out comes the primitive man as they fight to see who'll play with her! (S6, E10)

programme.title: South Park: A Ladder to Heaven
programme.desc: A Ladder To Heaven: The boys break into the McKormick house to try and find a winning ticket. Whilst there Cartman mistakenly drinks Kenny's ashes and starts to have some strange visions... (S6, E12)

programme.title: South Park: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers
programme.desc: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers: The boys are dressed up in full 'Middle Earth' gear, and are sent on a quest by Randy to deliver a video to Butter's parents. (S6, E13)
programme.sub-title: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers

programme.title: South Park: The Death Camp of Tolerance
programme.desc: The Death Camp of Tolerance: Mr. Garrison does what he can to get fired for being gay so he can sue the school for millions of dollars. (S6, E14)

programme.title: South Park: The Biggest Douche in the...
programme.desc: The Biggest Douche in the Universe: Cartman is rushed to hospital after again being possessed by Kenny. Chef believes a TV psychic can help but Stan isn't so sure... (S6, E15)

programme.title: South Park: My Future Self n' Me
programme.desc: My Future Self 'n' Me: After meeting his failed self from the future, Stan decides to avoid drink and drugs - but why does Butters also have a good-for-nothing future self staying with him? (S6, E16)

programme.title: South Park: Red Sleigh Down
programme.desc: Red Sleigh Down: Cartman's 'naughty or nice' accountant informs him that he has been too bad to earn his Christmas gift. All aboard Mr Hankey's Poo-Choo train for a trip to the North Pole! (S6, E17)

programme.title: South Park: Freak Strike
programme.desc: Freak Strike: The boys decide to create a freak in order to win a prize on a TV show - will Butters' case of "Chinballalitis" be enough to win? And will he be discovered by the freaks union? (S6, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Asspen: When the boys go on a ski vacation, it's '80s-teen-movie central as Stan is challenged to a ski race by a professional skier named Tad. Only a "montage" can help Stan now! (S6, E02)

programme.title: South Park: The New Terrance and Phillip Move Trailer
programme.desc: The Terrance and Phillip Movie Trailer: The gang are desperate to see the Terrance and Phillip trailer (featuring during 'The Russell Crowe Show') but events conspire against them. (S6, E05)
programme.sub-title: The New Terrance and Phillip Move Trailer

programme.title: South Park: Fun with Veal
programme.desc: Fun With Veal: When the boys discover that veal is made from baby cows they are horrified. Time for a "terrorist" mission to rescue the poor little blighters from their deathly fate! (S6, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples
programme.desc: Krazy K******s: Christopher Reeve arrives in town and Jimmy and Timmy aren't happy with the attention he gets. They form a club called "The Crips" - unaware of the gang that shares the name! (S7, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Toilet Paper
programme.desc: Toilet Paper: Mrs. Dreibel gives the boys detention for making a phallus out of clay in art class. Angry, they take revenge by toilet papering her house. Officer Barbrady is on their trail. (S7, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Fat Butt and Pancake Head
programme.desc: Fat Butt and Pancake Head: When Cartman wins a diversity event with his offensive hand puppet impersonation of Jennifer Lopez, Kyle is enraged. Soon the real J-Lo turns up, mightily peeved! (S7, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Lil' Crime Stoppers
programme.desc: Lil' Crime Stoppers: Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny decide to play detective; they go around the town solving minor "crimes" for a dollar. It's not long before they're busting meth labs! (S7, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Red Man's Greed
programme.desc: Red Man's Greed: When the entire town is bought out by a Native American casino, the boys come up with a plan to get their homes back - but is more gambling really the solution? (S7, E07)

programme.title: South Park: South Park Is Gay
programme.desc: South Park is Gay! The TV show Queer Eye For The Straight Guy is sweeping the nation and the men of South Park are embracing metrosexuality, but what evil plan are the hosts plotting? (S7, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Christian Rock Hard
programme.desc: Christian Hard Rock: The boys form a band called Moop, but disagree on what direction they should take. Cartman leaves the band and bets them he will have a platinum record first! (S7, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Grey Dawn
programme.desc: Grey Dawn: There's an epidemic in South Park. An epidemic of senior citizen related driving accidents! When their licenses are all revoked they decide to fight back military style! (S7, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Casa Bonita: Cartman is overjoyed at going to a Mexican restaurant for Kyle's birthday but is crushed when he finds out Butters is invited instead. He'll have to make Butters "disappear". (S7, E11)

programme.title: South Park: All About Mormons
programme.desc: All About The Mormons: A new family moves to South Park and their son Gary is an unusually perfect Mormon - this angers the boys no end! Will Stan beat him up or go for a family dinner?! (S7, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Butt Out
programme.desc: Butt Out: When the boys' smoking leads to a nasty incident, it's the cigarettes that are blamed rather than them. Cue the glutinous Rob Reiner to arrive in town with his anti-smoking lobby! (S7, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Raisins
programme.desc: Raisins: When Wendy breaks up with Stan he takes it hard. The boys decide to take him to the restaurant Raisins, where all of the employees are preteen girls who enjoy wearing heavy make-up. (S7, E14)

programme.title: South Park: It's Christmas In Canada
programme.desc: It's Christmas In Canada: A law is passed in Canada, meaning poor lil' Ike must return to his biological parents. The boys set out to stop this but who is the evil mastermind behind the law? (S7, E15)

programme.title: South Park: Good Times with Weapons
programme.desc: Good Times With Weapons: After buying martial arts weapons at a local flea market, the boys are transformed into anime Japanese Warriors, with dire consequences for poor Professor Chaos. (S8, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: AWESOM-O
programme.desc: AWESOM-O: When Cartman disguises himself as a robot in order to play a prank on Butters, he ends up being used by movie execs to come up with film ideas and captured by the military! (S8, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Up the Down Steroid
programme.desc: Up The Down Steroid: Jimmy is due to take part in the Special Olympics but what dodgy substance is he talked into taking? Cartman fakes being disabled so he can enter and win a $1,000. (S8, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Goobacks
programme.desc: Goobacks: South Park is swamped by workers from the future, who take all the jobs for less pay. The men of South Park go to unusual lengths to stop them. "Dey turk err jurbs!" (S8, E07)

programme.desc: Con la misma moneda: en el pueblo de San Fernando, el comisario don Miguel, su hija Rosita y Julian, novio de ella, reciben a Roberto, que llega con su hermana enferma Laura Elena y que desea adquirir tierras del lugar.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: La Marca del Gavilán
programme.desc: La marca del gavilan: en San Fernand, los compadres Manuel y Jose, sicarios del gavilan, asesinan por equivocacion al viudo Pablo, padre de un bebe a quien llama su tesoro: eso le cuesta la vida.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: El Látigo Negro Contra los Farsantes
programme.desc: El farsante: mientras Julián está en la capital comprando ganado, para disgusto de su novia Rosita, sin saber que llega a San Fernando Rogelio, un rico hacendado.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: La Muerte Pasa Lista
programme.desc: Misteriosas muertes de personas y robos de ganado, llevan al latigo negro a investigar quien esta detras de todo esto, los pueblerinos de San Fernando no se sienten a gusto, en la comisaria no hacen nada por temor a que tambien les hagan algo.

programme.title: Charro A La Fuerza
programme.desc: Clara, es una bella mujer que al fallecer sus padres se queda bajo el cuidado de su tia Balbina, ellas viven comodamente en la Ciudad de México. Pronto les cambiará la vida cuando Balbina recibe la noticia de que su padre Don Aureliano ha fallecido.

programme.title: El transportador 3
programme.desc: Frank Martin es un indiscutible especialista en entregas de alto riesgo. En esta ocasión está obligado bajo amenazas a trasladar dos voluminosas bolsas y una joven ucraniana desde Marsella hasta Odessa

programme.title: Derailed
programme.desc: ¡En un tren fuera de control que retiene rehenes y el agente de armas biológicas de alta tecnología, Kristoff (Van Damme) se convierte en un ejército de un solo hombre para descarrilar a los terroristas y salvar las vidas de todos a bordo!

programme.title: Rambo 4
programme.desc: El veterano de Vietnam John Rambo ha sobrevivido a muchas pruebas terribles en su vida y desde entonces se ha retirado a una existencia simple y aislada en Tailandia, donde pasa su tiempo capturando serpientes para artistas locales.

programme.title: CAOS
programme.desc: Dos policías, un novato (Phillipe) y un veterano (Statham) persiguen a un exitoso ladrón de bancos (Snipes)

programme.title: Institnto predador
programme.desc: Frank captura animales salvajes en la jungla brasileña, incluido un jaguar blanco de 180 kilos. Los embarca en el mismo barco que un asesino arrestado. El asesino se libera y libera a los animales.

programme.title: El protector
programme.desc: Billy Wong, un policía de Nueva York que usa artes marciales, investiga junto a su compañero el secuestro de Laura, hija de un millonario sospechoso de vínculos con un traficante de Hong Kong.

programme.title: Érase una vez en China y América
programme.desc: Jet Li es Wong Fei-Hong, un héroe chino que viaja a América, es salvado por indígenas y lucha contra la explotación de trabajadores chinos por un tirano local.

programme.title: Retroceder Nunca, Rendirse Jamás
programme.desc: Tras ver a su padre derrotado en su propio dojo, un joven estudiante de kárate aprende artes marciales del espíritu de Bruce Lee. Con ello, se propone derrotar a la mafia soviética de Seattle, liderada por el terrible Ivan Kraschinski.

programme.title: THE EXPENDABLES
programme.desc: En 'The Expendables' el trío de héroes de acción compuesto por Stallone, Statham y Li formarán parte de un comando de mercenarios que se infiltrarán en un país de Sudamérica y lucharán contra un un cruel dictador para liberar a la población.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: Inspector Eddie Chan es asignado para proteger Wong YatFei, un Rico hombre de negocios. A pesar de los esfuerzos de Eddia, ha secuestrado a Wong.

programme.title: Underworld
programme.desc: Selene, una guerrera vampiro, está inmersa en un conflicto entre vampiros y hombres lobo, mientras se enamora de Michael, un humano que es buscado por hombres lobo por razones desconocidas.

programme.title: Trol: Destrucción Total
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes investiga una serie de misteriosos asesinatos de osos, pero se entera de que están ocurriendo cosas mucho más peligrosas. Empiezan a seguir a un misterioso cazador, enterándose de que en realidad es un cazador de trolls.

programme.title: El nunca murió
programme.desc: Jack, un antisocial, sale de su zona de confort cuando el mundo exterior golpea su puerta y no puede contener su violento pasado.

programme.title: Cuenta Regresiva
programme.desc: Un profesor universitario se encuentra con una serie de números encontrados en una cápsula de tiempo, y llega a darse cuenta de que han predicho cada desastre de los últimos 50 años.

programme.title: La Fuente de la Vida
programme.desc: Con las actuaciones de Hugh Jackman y Rachel Weisz, se entreteje un cuento acerca de la búsqueda de un hombre por encontrar "el árbol de la vida" que le dará vida eterna.

programme.title: Las Vegas Frankenstein
programme.desc: Cuando el popular hipnotizador de Las Vegas, Victor Van Pelt, hereda el diario de Mary Shelley, cree que tiene la clave para el próximo gran espectáculo de Las Vegas

programme.title: Cuenta Regresiva
programme.desc: Un profesor universitario se encuentra con una serie de números encontrados en una cápsula de tiempo, y llega a darse cuenta de que han predicho cada desastre de los últimos 50 años.

programme.title: La Fuente de la Vida
programme.desc: Con las actuaciones de Hugh Jackman y Rachel Weisz, se entreteje un cuento acerca de la búsqueda de un hombre por encontrar "el árbol de la vida" que le dará vida eterna.

programme.title: Crónicas Mutantes
programme.desc: En el siglo XXIII, el mayor Mitch Hunter (Jane) lidera una lucha contra un ejército de necromutantes que habitan en el mundo subterráneo.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Devastada por el asesinato sin sentido de un amigo, una adolescente tiene una sesión espiritista para comunicarse por última vez e involuntariamente invita a una entidad malévola a su propia casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la ciudad de Springfield, estado de Illinois, el Lake Club es un monumento a una época pasada: un salón de baile donde multitud de personas alguna vez prosperaron, acompañados de los sonidos del jazz clásico.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Sandra e Isidro Nuno experimentan entidades oscuras que tienen como objetivo a sus dos hijas, Sabrina y Shanon, en su casa de Chicago. Desesperados por ayuda, los Nunos recurren a un "guerrero espiritual" para combatir a los demonios.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El sueño de Dana Walters de abrir una tienda de disfraces se ve interrumpido cuando descubren que el edificio que acaba de comprar está embrujado. Cuando el fantasma se vuelve más peligroso, ella llama a un espiritista psíquico local para que investigue.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El ex oficial de policía Joe Mignano se casa con su novia de la infancia, Danika, y los dos se enfrentan a una peligrosa actividad poltergeist en su casa en Rhode Island. Se ponen en contacto con un conocido demonólogo en busca de ayuda.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un fanático de las casas embrujadas y su sobrina compran un antiguo hospital en Tooele, Utah. A medida que lo transforman en una “casa encantada”, experimentan una serie de eventos paranormales.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cathy Heglund vive una pesadilla cuando se ve obligada a regresar al hogar que atormentó su infancia. Cuando los espíritus se vuelven agresivos, los investigadores paranormales se unen para darle lo que ella ha deseado durante décadas... respuestas.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una pareja se ve atacada por fuerzas espirituales convocadas por un ex celoso. A medida que las fuerzas se vuelven más violentas, recurren a múltiples expertos en su intento de romper la maldición por cualquier medio antes de que los disuelva.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Mary Jo Chudley queda encantada con un par de muñecas coleccionables y las lleva a casa. Los llama "Gretchen" y "Lily Mae" y pronto sufre una enfermedad relacionada con la sangre que casi la mata. ¿Son las muñecas responsables?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una pareja remodela una antigua granja, despertando un espíritu que se burla de ellos y de su pequeña hija, en un intento de resolver deudas centenarias. Después de un encuentro casi fatal, una médium y dos investigadores se unen para poner fin al acoso.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando una joven pareja comienza a experimentar eventos inexplicables, descubren que el residente anterior nunca se fue. Los investigadores paranormales se dan cuenta de que el edificio necesita una liberación antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El sueño de Kim y Eric Masson de tener un restaurante se ve interrumpido cuando se dan cuenta de que el edificio está embrujado. Cuando la inquietud se vuelve terrible, los Masson acuden a la ayuda de investigadores paranormales.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Los espiritistas algunas veces hablan sobre cierta región de la existencia donde los espíritus vagan libres de cuerpos materiales, y ellos la llaman “la otra vida”.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En este mundo, la verdadera maldad existe. Acecha dentro de las sombras más oscuras, así como en los lugares más sencillos. Se disfraza con muchas máscaras para engañarnos y, finalmente, destruirnos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La ciencia moderna nos afirma que, en el nivel más simple, el mundo material no es más que energía y que todos estamos conectados de forma física con el mundo que nos rodea.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Ron y Nancy están convencidos de que su nuevo hogar es demasiado bueno para ser verdad: la histórica casa Baltimore se adapta de forma ideal a su presupuesto y además es tan grande como para alojar a su gran familia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Existen algunos lazos que no pueden romperse, tal como el vínculo que se establece entre una madre y su hija... o el vínculo psíquico entre un asesino y su víctima.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Clara y su familia se mudan a una pequeña casa en la zona rural de Hinsdale, Nueva York, se dan cuenta de que la paz de la vida en el campo es simplemente una ilusión y la amenaza de muerte es muy real.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La casa de rancho de Ed y Beth parece el lugar perfecto para criar a su niño pequeño, hasta que descubren que no están solos y una espesa niebla oscura se cierne sobre la casa y crece día a día.

programme.title: Los cuatro Juanes
programme.desc: Los cuatro famosos Juanes: Juan Colorado, Juan Sin Miedo, Juan Pistolas y Juan Charrasqueado pasan peligrosas aventuras para llevar un importante cargamento de armas y municiones desde Veracruz hasta un pueblo sitiado por las fuerzas del gobierno.

programme.title: Los diablos del terror
programme.desc: Un policía federal llega a un pueblo desolado por una secta de encapuchados que deja una cara de satanás en sus víctimas.

programme.title: Mañana serán hombres
programme.desc: El director de cine Enrique trabaja en la película "Yo morí a los veinte" con los jóvenes actores que ayudarán al argumento final de la película mediante sus historias.

programme.title: Me he de comer esa tuna
programme.desc: En la zona rural de México, un joven compite con su mejor amigo de la escuela por el amor de una mujer cuyo matrimonio ha sido arreglado por sus padres.

programme.title: Rosario
programme.desc: Una mujer mata accidentalmente a su marido mientras actuaba en una obra de teatro.

programme.title: Tin Tan y Las Modelos
programme.desc: Tin-Tan y su esposa Severa son los directores del Patronato de la Moral y Etica Social. Sin embargo Tin-Tan tuvo como antepasado a Casanova, quien le da tres maravillosas lecciones de amor con tres hermosas jovenes, Rosa, Teresa y Mapita.

programme.title: Toña Machetes
programme.desc: Toña Machetes es una brava mujer que logró elevarse por encima de los prejuicios sociales de los años 30. Dueña de una gran extensión de tierra y temida por su carácter, vive separada de su esposo aristócrata y acechada por constantes amenazas de muerte.

programme.title: Tres lecciones de amor
programme.desc: Tin-Tan es un vendedor de productos de belleza que conoce aun grupo de hermosas jóvenes que aspiran a ser modelos. Decide ayudarlas y organiza una exhibición de modas que las hace triunfar en la Televisión.

programme.title: Yo soy Chucho el Roto
programme.desc: El carpintero Jesús Arriaga se enamora de Erica Matilde, pero los tíos de ella se oponen a la relación y lo arrestan por robo. Se fuga de la cárcel y se convierte en un bandido generoso.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy celebra el éxito de las Granjas Tegridad, mientras Cartman se reusa a ser vacunado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman está seguro de que la nueva dieta basada en plantas en la cafetería de la escuela le causó un ataque al corazón

programme.title: South Park

programme.sub-title: Especial de Halloween de Granjas Tegridad

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La madre de Kyle se hace un trasplante fecal y los niños están en busca del mejor microbioma.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Scott Malkinson está desesperado por impresionar a la chica nueva de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Papá Noel se está robando toda la alegría de la temporada navideña de la ciudad.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.desc: La clase de 4to grado tiene prohibido ir en pijama a la escuela en el día más importante del año.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan se horroriza al darse cuenta de que ha malinterpretado a uno de los mejores escritores de todos los tiempos.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.sub-title: Hierba Crédigre Especial del día de San Patricio

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le cuenta a sus amigos sobre un extraño sueño que tuvo en donde unos ''visitantes'' lo abducen y le ponen una sonda anal. Pero al parecer, no fue sólo un sueño, ya que algo está desollando a las vacas del pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman gana el concurso de ensayos "Salva a nuestro frágil planeta" y se anuncia que Kathie Lee Gifford le dará el premio. Esto enoja a Wendy, porque cree que Cartman hizo trampa y al Señor Garrison porque odia a Gifford.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se van de caza con Jimbo, el tío de Stan, y su viejo amigo Ned. Mientras tanto, un volcán está a punto de hacer erupción y la alcaldesa McDaniels aprovecha la oportunidad para promocionar al pueblo de South Park en televisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan tiene un nuevo perro llamado Sparky que resulta ser gay, por lo que todos sus compañeros se burlan de él. Cuando Sparky se va de casa, Stan lo busca en el Santuario de Animales del Gran Gay Al y aprende algo sobre la homosexualidad.
programme.sub-title: El gran crucero del Gran Gay Al

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El abuelo de Stan cumple 102 años y quiere suicidarse, pero al no poder hacerlo, le pide a Stan que lo ayude.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny es aplastado por la Estación Espacial Mir y se convierte en un zombi que desata la epidemia por todo el pueblo. Pero el doctor diagnostíca a todos como si tuvieran conjuntivitis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando Damián, el hijo de Satanás, llega a South Park, él y su padre anuncian que la batalla final con Jesús se realizará en una lucha de boxeo que decidirá quién es el más fuerte.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de ver un comercial sobre la hambruna en África, los chicos deciden patrocinar a un niño y envían dinero a la organización de Sally Struthers con la esperanza de obtener un reloj digital deportivo a cambio.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La señora Broflovski protesta por las actividades navideñas que se realizan en la escuela. Mientras tanto, Kyle se siente solo por ser judío y nadie le cree cuando trata de convencer al pueblo sobre la existencia del Señor Mojón.
programme.sub-title: El Señor Mojón, la mierda navideña

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Chef tiene una novia y al parecer es una relación seria, así que los chicos se preocupan de que pueda convertirse en un hombre diferente. Al mismo tiempo, Cartman tiene problemas en la vista y odia a su oculista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños obligan a dos de sus compañeros de clase, Tweek y Craig, a pelear en el patio de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras están de campamento en el bosque, Cartman descubre una especie de animal en extinción. Al principio, la ciudad se alegra de haberlo salvado, pero luego se dan cuenta de que es muy molesto.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La clase del señor Garrison es visitada por Petey, el panda del acoso sexual, quien les enseña a los chicos sobre el tema. Luego, Cartman decide demandar a Stan porque le dijo ''lame culo''.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La señora Cartman se va a una fiesta por la lluvia de meteoritos y deja a su hijo a cuidado de Shelley. Ahora, Cartman tiene que lidiar con los abusos de Shelley, su novio de 22 años y su gata que está celo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan tiene que ir con sus padres a una aburrida fiesta por la lluvia de meteoritos donde los únicos chicos que hay son Butters, Pip, y Dougie. Mientras tanto, Randy y Gerald pasan por una situación incómoda en un jacuzzi.
programme.sub-title: Dos hombres desnudos en un Jacuzzi

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En la noche de la lluvia de meteoritos, Kyle, Kenny y Ike van al campamento de exploradores judíos, donde se aparece Moisés, al que le encanta que le hagan ofrendas de figuras hechas de macarrones y collares hechos con palomitas de maíz.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se enloquecen por "Chinpokomon" (parodia de Pókemon) y quieren comprar los muñecos, los videojuegos y cualquier cosa de ellos. Lo malo es que los japoneses que los hacen les están lavando el cerebro para invadir Pearl Harbor.

programme.desc: En los tiempos de caballeros valientes y hermosas princesas, un joven artista se enamora.

programme.title: La colonia

programme.title: Actividades criminales

programme.title: La Emboscada
programme.desc: Cuando el ladrón profesional Robert MacDougal se ve envuelto en un juego de intrigas internacionales, con la investigadora Gin Baker , los fraudes y trampas policiacas empiezan.

programme.title: Hurricane
programme.desc: Junio de 1940. En la Francia ocupada por Alemania, el joven polaco Jan Zumbach se hace pasar por un viajante de relojes suizo para conseguir llegar a un aeródromo.

programme.title: 1492: La conquista del paraíso
programme.desc: Retrata la vida del atrevido explorador Cristóbal Colón. Un difícil y sorprendente viaje hasta una tierra desconocida por el mundo, América; el efecto sobre las tribus indígenas y la vuelta del héroe a España hasta su muerte.

programme.title: Clase sangrienta
programme.desc: La estudiante de instituto Paula Carson tiene dos pretendientes entre sus compañeros de clase: Dwight, el "chico malo", y Brian, un joven algo perturbado que acaba de salir de un hospital mental.

programme.title: Life of Brian
programme.desc: Brian nace en un pesebre de Belén el mismo día que Jesucristo. Un cúmulo de desgraciados y tronchantes equívocos le harán llevar una vida paralela a la del verdadero Hijo de Dios.

programme.title: Por la piel de un policía
programme.desc: Víctima de manipulación, todos los policías de la ciudad buscan al policía Choucas por dos asesinatos.

programme.title: El general murió al amanecer
programme.desc: En los años 30, en plena guerra civil china, el aventurero O'Hara, indignado por el trato que el general Yang dispensa a sus compatriotas, envía dinero al señor Wu para que compre en Shangai armas.

programme.title: El dulce porvenir
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar se despeña montaña abajo y se hunde en un lago helado. En el accidente mueren todos los niños del pueblo. El abogado Mitchell Stevens se entrevista con los padres y les propone llevar el caso a los tribunales.

programme.title: La felicidad nunca viene sola
programme.desc: Un músico conoce a una mujer con una vida muy distinta y ambos se enamoran.

programme.title: Mi pie izquierdo
programme.desc: Ganadora de Oscars (1989): Mejor Actor y Actriz secundaria. Basada en la biografía de Christy Brown. Aquejado de parálisis cerebral, gracias a su tenacidad y al incondicional apoyo de su madre, consiguió su integración en la sociedad.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Un hombre convence a su amigo para trabajar como gigoló, lo que provoca situaciones cómicas y complicadas.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: Gangster Nº 1
programme.desc: Un mafioso recuerda su ascenso en el Londres de los años sesenta. La ambición y la envidia lo llevan a traicionar a su mentor, Freddie Mays, para convertirse en el gánster más temido de la ciudad.

programme.title: El valor del honor
programme.desc: Castigado por su alcoholismo y rebeldía, un joven blanco (Charlie Sheen) es enviado a una prisión militar repleta de reclusos negros liderados por Stokes (Laurence Fishburne) y supervisados por un sargento sádico (Martin Sheen).

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: El gran golpe
programme.desc: Una banda liderada por Macao Park planea un gran golpe en un casino. Pero sin honor entre ladrones, cada uno trama su propio plan para quedarse con el botín.

programme.title: Alienoid 1
programme.desc: Los guardianes extraterrestres usan huéspedes humanos como prisiones mientras un guardián rastrea a los fugitivos a través de los siglos, mezclando hechiceros taoístas de la dinastía Goryeo y tecnología futurista.

programme.title: Redada mortal
programme.desc: Un hábil luchador es contratado para neutralizar al equipo de seguridad de una fábrica local y permitir que su empleador extorsione a su poderoso dueño.

programme.title: Batalla espacial: La armada ataca
programme.desc: En 2420, después de que una raza de alienígenas y poderosos magos esclavizaran a gran parte de la humanidad, un grupo de rebeldes organiza un contraataque pilotando una flota de naves espaciales.

programme.title: White Space
programme.desc: La tripulación de una nave pesquera espacial se enfrenta a una criatura cósmica gigantesca y mortal mientras opera en un sector inexplorado del espacio.

programme.title: Take the Money and Run
programme.desc: Una serie de entrevistas, con quienes lo conocieron, nos introduce en la vida del incompetente atracador Virgil Starkwell, que desde el principio estuvo abocado a la delincuencia.

programme.title: Mi casa en París
programme.desc: Mathias, un desventurado neoyorquino sin esposa, sin hijos y sin un céntimo, hereda de su padre, con quien no se hablaba, una enorme en casa en París, de la que quiere deshacerse lo antes posible.

programme.title: Los líos de Gray
programme.desc: Gray y Sam (Heather Graham y Tom Cavanagh) son hermanos, pero tan compatibles e inseparables que la gente cree que son pareja.

programme.title: Movie 43
programme.desc: Antología de historias cómicas y absurdas protagonizadas por numerosos actores famosos: Hugh Jackman, Richard Gere, Emma Stone, Halle Berry, Kate Winslet o Naomi Watts.

programme.title: Entrega especial
programme.desc: Una mujer que se dedica a la mensajería especial recibe el más insólito encargo: deberá recoger a una adolescente rebelde en el domicilio paterno situado en China y entregarla a su madre en Occidente.

programme.title: Dance-Off
programme.desc: Brandon y Jasmine son dos bailarines pertenecientes a academias rivales que deben competir por un gran premio. En su viaje a la final el enfrentamiento se va convirtiendo en amor.

programme.title: Ana y Bruno
programme.desc: Ana se hace amiga de los seres imaginarios de los pacientes de un hospital psiquiátrico, donde recientemente ha llegado junto con su madre. Con la ayuda de sus nuevos amigos intentará escapar de ahí para buscar a su padre y reunir a su familia.

programme.title: Viaje a Italia
programme.desc: Steve Coogan y Rob Brydon reciben el encargo de un nuevo viaje gastronómico, esta vez por Italia. Estos dos improbables amigos conducen por todo el país mientras vuelven a discutir sobre la vida, el amor y el cine.

programme.title: Incidencias
programme.desc: Los pasajeros del tren comienzan a enfrentarse entre sí cuando su viaje se detiene en medio de la nada durante un clima peligroso.

programme.title: Papa Moll & The Chocolate Factory

programme.title: Dictado

programme.title: Los viajeros de la noche
programme.desc: Un joven cowboy, seducido por una chica nueva en la ciudad, descubre que ha sido mordido por un vampiro. Lentamente se convierte en una criatura de la noche alimentándose con la sangre de sus víctimas.

programme.title: Crímenes del futuro

programme.title: Secuestrada en la isla
programme.desc: Una madre soltera arriesga su vida para salvar a su hija, fascinada por las estrellas, de las garras de una red de tráfico sexual dirigida por un agente de talentos en una isla aislada.

programme.title: Puntos extra por asesinato
programme.desc: Maisy se traslada a la universidad de su difunta hermana para investigar las circunstancias de su muerte.

programme.title: A pleno sol
programme.desc: Tom Ripley es un prodigioso impostor, gorrón, falsificador y delincuente de la improvisación en general

programme.title: La muerte y la doncella
programme.desc: En un país imaginario que acaba de sufrir una terrible dictadura, viven Paulina Escobar y su marido Gerardo, un prestigioso abogado. Una noche, Gerardo tiene una avería con su coche, pero un hombre se ofrece a ayudarle…

programme.title: Alarma en el Expreso
programme.desc: Centroeuropa. El tren Transcontinental sufre un retraso. Los pasajeros pernoctan en un hotel. Iris Henderson habla con una anciana, la Sra. Froy. En el tren, Iris se da cuenta de la desaparición de la anciana, pero los pasajeros afirman que no existe.

programme.title: El autoestopista
programme.desc: Dos pescadores recogen a un autoestopista que resulta ser un convicto psicótico.

programme.title: El ministerio del miedo
programme.desc: Tras dos años de reclusión, Stephen Neale abandona el sanatorio mental de Lembridge. Se encuentra entonces con un mundo distinto que nada tiene que ver con lo que él conocía.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Aflojando el Fatídico Relámpago
programme.desc: Dylan encuentra una estación espacial llena de niños que creen que está allí para traer la paz matando a sus enemigos.

programme.title: Andrómeda: D Menos Cero

programme.desc: Una corriente de deslizamiento envía a la Andrómeda de vuelta en el tiempo a justo antes de que cayera la Mancomunidad. La tripulación debe intervenir para preservar la historia.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Aburrido con la dirección que está tomando su vida y aún excluido del atletismo, Curtis decide utilizar su nuevo poder de cambiar de género para poder competir de nuevo.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 3
programme.desc: Aún intentando cumplir con su destino convirtiéndose en SuperHoodie, Simon evita que Peter, un nerd de las caricaturas, que sea atracado. Peter esá conmocionado con SuperHoodie -al menos encontró un héroe para idolatrar.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 4
programme.desc: Un anciano planifica usar alguno de los superpoderes de Curtis para regresar en el tiempo y asesinar a Hitler. Pero el plan sienta mal y la banda se dan cuentan en un mundo alternativo.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 5
programme.desc: Mientras hace un servicio a la comunidad en el hospital local, Kelly se ve atrapada en el cuerpo de Jen, una víctima en coma. Jen, paseando en el cuerpo de Kelly, sale, dejando a Kelly en coma.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 6
programme.desc: Después de una noche bebido con una chica misteriosa, Rudy descubre que tiene un extraño superpoder STD. Con solo 24 horas para deshacer el hechizo, Rudy acude a Simon para ayudarle a encontrar a la chica.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 7
programme.desc: Cuando Seth descubre el superpoder de la resurrección, lo utiiza para devolverle la vida a su exnovia de nuevo a la vida. Pero al poco tiempo se da cuenta de que el nuevo superpoder tiene inesperadas consecuencias.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 8
programme.desc: La banda está sorprendida cuando un falso medium con un superpoder trae los rostros familiares del pasado de nuevo a la vida. Se encuentran cara a cara con dos trabajadores a prueba que serán asesinados.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Los nuevos miembros de la banda, Finn y Jess, se ponen los monos naranjas icónicos para el primer día de servicios a la comunidad y conoce a su trabajador de la condicional.

programme.title: Mopias

programme.title: Mopias
programme.desc: Tras la desaparición de Pere, Bel nota que nadie recuerda a su hermano. Con la ayuda de Judith, Gori y Hilda irá a buscarlo. Guiados por una extraña señal sonora, llegan a un refugio donde encuentran a Ginebra, una mujer misteriosa que oculta secretos.

programme.title: Mopias
programme.desc: Bel y Judith deciden volver solas al refugio de Ginebra para encontrar pistas de Pere. La mujer les ofrece ayuda, pero necesita objetos de Pere. Esto lleva a Bel a enfrentarse a su pasado y a Nofre, el coordinador del campamento.

programme.title: Mopias
programme.desc: Bel y Judith buscan a Pere con las indicaciones de Ginebra, en un camino largo y lleno de peligros por las entrañas de la sierra de Tramuntana. Un viaje que pone a prueba las capacidades y los miedos de las dos chicas.

programme.title: Ascensión: Episodio 1

programme.desc: Gault halla una libreta con textos sobre una revolución. En el cuarto de Stokes, se encuentra una pistola que lo convierte en sospechoso del asesinato de Lorelei.

programme.title: Ascensión: Episodio 3

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Michael Brecker Band
programme.sub-title: Michael Brecker Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, decorated American saxophonist and composer Michael Brecker and his band played at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Accompanied by bassist Jeff Andrews, drummer Adam Nussbaum, pianist Joey Calderazzo, and guitarist Mike Stern, Brecker displayed his virtuosity in spades.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés, Concha Buika, Rodney Barreto & Dreiser Durruthy Bombale
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them were Chucho Valdes and his Afro-Cuban Messengers, the prime example of Latin-inspired jazz music. Together with vocalists Concha Buika and Dreiser Durruthy Bombale, Rodney Barreto on drums, Gaston Joya on double bass, Yaroldy Abreu Robles on congas, and Reinaldo Melian Alvarez on trumpet, the legendary pianist brings the streets of Havana to the festival's stage.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin' Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day', as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice. Her vocals, which were strongly inspired by instrumental jazz, are admired for their deeply personal and intimate sound. This compilation features recordings from the 1950s of Billie Holiday singing a string of her greatest successes. Enjoy this unique footage of one of jazz's all-time greats!

programme.title: Raul Midón
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind' was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra & Andres Gabetta
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi's famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: Centuries ago, the mighty warrior Kaulder (Vin Diesel) vanquished the all-powerful Witch Queen, but in the moments before his death he was cursed with immortality.

programme.title: Toast
programme.desc: Growing up in Wolverhampton, young Nigel Slater dreams of becoming a great cook, despite his mother's limited culinary skills. Following her death, Nigel struggles with his new stepmother, Joan, whose talent in the kitchen sparks a rivalry as they both seek his father's affection. After finding inspiration through a job in a pub kitchen, Nigel embraces his identity and sets off for London to pursue his culinary ambitions. Contains mild language and sex references.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: A film noir fan gets caught up in his own crazy tale when a quirky, adventure-loving femme fatale bursts into his life, flipping everything upside down. Who knew love could be wilder than the movies?

programme.title: Killer Sofa
programme.desc: When a killer Lazy Boy chair falls in love with a girl, it's up to a disgraced Jewish Rabbi, a Voodoo sorceress and a couple of broken-hearted detectives to ﬁgure out how to stop the bloody carnage that will follow.

programme.title: Summer in the Shade
programme.desc: Summer, 1997. A holiday to Cornwall forces troubled 13-year-old Grace to confront her demons.

programme.title: Street Kings
programme.desc: When evidence implicates a veteran LAPD cop in the execution of a fellow officer, he is forced to go up against the cop culture he's been a part of his entire career.

programme.title: Daybreakers
programme.desc: The year is 2019, and an unknown plague has transformed the world's population into blood-thirsty vampires. As humans and their blood become more scarce, vampires must search for new ways to satisfy their craving.

programme.title: Open Water
programme.desc: When a couple is stranded while scuba diving, they soon realize they are in the middle of shark-infested waters in this intense, critically acclaimed thriller.

programme.title: Spooks: The Greater Good
programme.desc: When a terrorist escapes custody during a routine handover, Will Holloway must team with disgraced MI5 Intelligence Chief Harry Pearce to track him down before an imminent terrorist attack on London.

programme.title: Dune
programme.desc: A Duke's son leads his warriors against an evil baron and tries to destroy a galaxy-wide 'spice' trade.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: A man from another world crash lands on Earth during the age of the Vikings.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: Banished by the king, Hercules harnesses his powers and gathers an army to fight his way back to his kingdom.

programme.title: 12 Days Of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings (David Blue - SGU Stargate Universe, Ugly Betty) wins a small fortune at his local shopping mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.title: Saving Santa
programme.desc: Once upon a time, Santa operated with just a small workshop and a few elves. But, as Christmas has grown ever bigger, Santa has been forced to innovate! Now his cleverest elves develop amazing technology, including a hologram to hide the North Pole and a time machine to allow Santa to deliver presents to every home in the world, in just the one night. Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. But Bernard's invention is broken by a curious elf, causing the North Pole's power to fail and the hologram hiding it to disappear. Now exposed to the outside world, it is spotted by Santa's enemy, Neville Baddington, who is determined to steal Santa's secrets for himself. The only person who can stop him is Bernard.

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina and Franklin are seemingly the perfect couple, but after five years of marriage, a huge fight at Thanksgiving leads them to divorce, set to be finalised on Christmas day. As they try to move on with their lives, will the festive spirit pull them back together? Starring Erica Ash (Scary Movie 5, Survivor's Remorse) and Eva Marcille (The Young and the Restless).

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee (Kitana Kiki Rodriguez) is back on the block. Upon hearing that her pimp boyfriend (James Ransone) hasn't been faithful during the 28 days she was locked up, the working girl and her best friend, Alexandra (Mya Taylor), embark on a mission to get to the bottom of the scandalous rumour. Their rip-roaring odyssey leads them through various subcultures of Los Angeles, including an Armenian family dealing with their own repercussions of infidelity.

programme.title: All I See Is You
programme.desc: Directed by Marc Forster (World War Z) and described by The Guardian as "Intoxicating". Gina (Blake Lively) is blind and exclusively depends on her husband James (Jason Clarke) to see the world around her. While the two enjoy a colourful existence, their relationship is upended when Gina regains her sight and begins to experience the world with a brand new sense of wonder and independence.

programme.title: Aftermath
programme.desc: Inspired by astonishing true events, Aftermath tells the story of two strangers, Roman Melnyk, (Arnold Schwarzenegger: The Expendables), and an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy: Argo), whose lives become inextricably bound together after a devastating plane crash that resulted in the death of Romans family. A heart-pounding thriller brought to you by the producers of Everest.

programme.title: The Farm
programme.desc: FrightFest Presents. A brutal, gore-tastic slasher/survival horror, in the vein of The Texas Chainsaw Massacre and Wolf Creek. While on a road trip a couple decide to stop at a diner. Little do they know that ordering a hamburger will have terrible consequences. Their journey soon becomes a harrowing story of survival as they are kidnapped by local farmers. On their farm, humans are the main dish.

programme.title: The Bunker
programme.desc: This nighmareish horror will have you running towards the nearest exit. When Ella (Mischa Barton) discovers her Wall Street banker boyfriend is renting a secret storage unit, she becomes suspicious. Breaking in with her friend Molly (Emily Atack) they discover something sinister. Now trapped in the darkened building with a bunch of neurotic strangers, they must fight for their lives. Unmissable!
